# Simple Cipher starter

Run the character-code list with the sample Az!. The starting codes are 65, 122, and 33. Ask for an integer offset, add it to each code, and print the shifted list below the original list.

PS3-Simple-Cipher/starter/main.py.content:
message = input("Sample message: ")
codes = ""

for letter in message:
    codes += str(ord(letter)) + " "

print("Original codes:", codes.rstrip())

# Read an integer offset and print the shifted codes for the same message.

PS3-Simple-Cipher/solution/main.py.content:
message = input("Sample message: ")
offset = int(input("Numeric offset: "))
original = ""
shifted = ""

for letter in message:
    code = ord(letter)
    original += str(code) + " "
    shifted += str(code + offset) + " "

print("Original codes:", original.rstrip())
print("Shifted codes:", shifted.rstrip())

PS3-Caesar-Cipher/starter/README.md.content:
# Caesar Cipher starter

Enter z and a shift of 1. The diagnostic shows a shifted position of 26. Wrap positions within 0 through 25, convert them back to letters, and use the opposite shift to restore the message. Handle uppercase separately and carry other characters through unchanged.

PS3-Caesar-Cipher/solution/main.py.content:
def shift_ascii(message, shift):
    result = ""
    for letter in message:
        if "a" <= letter <= "z":
            base = ord("a")
        elif "A" <= letter <= "Z":
            base = ord("A")
        else:
            result += letter
            continue

        position = ord(letter) - base
        wrapped = (position + shift) % 26
        result += chr(base + wrapped)
    return result


message = input("Sample message: ")
shift = int(input("Shift: "))
shifted = shift_ascii(message, shift)
print("Shifted:", shifted)
print("Restored:", shift_ascii(shifted, -shift))

PS3-Uppercase-to-Lowercase/starter/READM.content:
# Uppercase to Lowercase starter

Run the character-code trace for Z. The uppercase-to-lowercase offset is ord("a") minus ord("A"). Add it only for A through Z. Preserve lowercase letters, spaces, numbers, and punctuation.

PS3-Uppercase-to-Lowercase/starter/main..content:
text = input("Enter a short line: ")
offset = ord("a") - ord("A")

for letter in text:
    print(letter, ord(letter))

# When a code is between ord("A") and ord("Z"), add offset.
# Assemble the changed and unchanged characters into one output.

PS3-Uppercase-to-Lowercase/solution/main.content:
text = input("Enter a short line: ")
offset = ord("a") - ord("A")
converted = ""

for letter in text:
    code = ord(letter)
    if ord("A") <= code <= ord("Z"):
        code += offset
    converted += chr(code)

print("Converted:", converted)
